note: Real encrypted attachments with the key and iv fixed, so the blob is the same bytes every time. Throwaway keys. See docs/E2E_ATTACHMENTS.md. Check yours with: node tools/e2e-kit/e2e-attachment.mjs reference.

recipe.key: 32 random bytes per file, base64url without padding
recipe.iv: 12 random bytes per file, base64url without padding
recipe.additionalData: the UTF-8 text e2e1-file (not the file name, not the message id)
recipe.blob: ciphertext followed by the 16-byte GCM tag, nothing else (the iv and the key are NOT in the blob)

positive.name: a file of one byte (the smallest the server takes: 17 bytes of blob)
a binary file with every byte value

negative.name: one bit of the ciphertext changed
one bit of the tag changed
the tag cut off (the blob is the ciphertext alone)
the iv put in front of the blob (some libraries do this; here the iv is in the tag text, not in the blob)
a key of 16 bytes (AES-128 is not used)
